NOT FOUND.

What I searched
- Listed corpora: ow_corpora (corpus "docs" present; no matching indexed content for this query).
- ow_query "passport renewal application submitted"
- ow_query "kind:form passport renewal application submitted date" (corpus=docs)
- ow_query "passport OR \"passport renewal\" OR \"renewal application\" submitted date OR submission OR \"date submitted\""
  - returned low_confidence hits that were CSV statement files showing only a header "date" (d20#18, d21#18, d22#18, d23#18) — no submission date for a passport renewal.
- ow_query "\"passport renewal\" \"application\" submitted OR \"date submitted\" OR \"submitted on\""
- ow_query "passport" (returned absent)
- a filesystem grep for "passport" under the documents folder:
  Path searched: {bench-cache}/personal_archive-full-9fc3b7379202/project/docs — no matches found.

Resultado: I could not find any document or page in the indexed corpus that states when the passport renewal application was submitted. I will not guess a date.

If you want, I can:
- Search a different corpus (if you have one name),
- Re-run a broader search, or
- Index/upload the document that contains the passport renewal application so I can read it and report the submission date.
